title: South Africa Orders SpaceX to Stop Unlicensed Starlink! 🛰️
body: South Africa Orders SpaceX to Stop Unlicensed Starlink! 🛰️

South Africa's communications minister revealed before parliament that the telecoms regulator issued a formal non-compliance notice to SpaceX on 14 October, ordering it to stop providing the Starlink service — satellite internet — because the company has been operating in the country without a licence for about 3 years, using imported devices and roaming packages from neighbouring countries.
At the heart of the dispute is a law requiring at least 30% of licence holders' ownership to belong to groups that were historically disadvantaged under apartheid.
Experts warn that the notice does not mean the service will be switched off immediately nationwide.
Do you support satellite internet companies having to comply with each country's laws? 🌍
